name: Gl1_NormPhys
description:
Renders NormPhys objects as cylinders of which diameter and color depends on NormPhys.normalForce magnitude.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.maxFn(=0)

	Value of NormPhys.normalForce corresponding to maxRadius<Gl1_NormPhys.maxRadius>. This value will be increased (but *not decreased* ) automatically.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.signFilter(=0)

	If non-zero, only display contacts with negative (-1) or positive (+1) normal forces; if zero, all contacts will be displayed.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.refRadius(=std::numeric_limits<Real>::infinity())

	Reference (minimum) particle radius; used only if maxRadius<Gl1_NormPhys.maxRadius> is negative. This value will be decreased (but *not increased* ) automatically. |yupdate|

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.maxRadius(=-1)

	Cylinder radius corresponding to the maximum normal force. If negative, auto-updated refRadius<Gl1_NormPhys.refRadius> will be used instead.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.slices(=6)

	Number of sphere slices; (see `glutCylinder reference <http://www.opengl.org/sdk/docs/man/xhtml/gluCylinder.xml>`_)

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.stacks(=1)

	Number of sphere stacks; (see `glutCylinder reference <http://www.opengl.org/sdk/docs/man/xhtml/gluCylinder.xml>`_)

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.maxWeakFn(=NaN)

	Value that divides contacts by their normal force into the 'weak fabric' and 'strong fabric'. This value is set as side-effect by utils.fabricTensor.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.weakFilter(=0)

	If non-zero, only display contacts belonging to the 'weak' (-1) or 'strong' (+1) fabric.

.. ystaticattr:: Gl1_NormPhys.weakScale(=1.)

	If maxWeakFn<Gl1_NormPhys.maxWeakFn> is set, scale radius of the weak fabric by this amount (usually smaller than 1). If zero, 1 pixel line is displayed. Colors are not affected by this value.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.
